jobs.title: Senior .NET SW Developer
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced R&D Software Developer focused on .NET application development to join our technology organization.

In this role, you will develop, high-performance, and secure software systems built with .NET technology, with a strong focus on real-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.

As an R&D Software Developer within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.

You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.

We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Achieve business goals through designing and developing code in the .NET technologies.
Design, develop and maintain microservices architecture for back-end.
Participate in code review.
Troubleshooting and bug fixing for all issues discovered during E2E testing
Share your experience and skills with other team members.
Proposing and elaborating with other team members on how to improve code quality, performance and stability.
Work closely with Product Owner, QA engineers to ensure successful project delivery

Your Background

University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
8+ years of experience in senior technical roles.
Advanced proficiency in .NET technology stack: C#, REST Web Services and .NET Core.
Assure high code quality through unit tests and adherence to software development best practices like Clean Code, SOLID, and code reviews.
Hands on knowledge in following areas:
Git version control system
Build management - Azure DevOps Pipelines, MSBuild,
Docker / podman
Kubernetes + Helm
SQL database knowledge

Demonstrate understanding of the concepts API Development and Consumption.
Practical knowledge of Kafka and C++ development in plus.
Demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low-latency systems.
Understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
Knowledge of non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring.
Understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards.
Experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU) in plus.
Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) in plus.
Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients.
Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
Excellent command of English (written and spoken).

More about us

We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us, in work and out.

We can provide more information during the recruitment process.

Our Benefits Offering For This Role Generally Includes

Private medical care and life insurance
Access to fitness and wellness programs
Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks
Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home
Spectacles and contact lenses allowance
Company events and team‑building activities
Psychological support program
Free parking available

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) - Poland
jobs.description:
Aras is a leading provider of digital thread solutions for product lifecycle management (PLM) and engineering AI. As one of the fastest growing PLM companies, our AI-native, low-code platform enables the rapid delivery of flexible solutions that connect teams across disciplines and functions to critical product data and agentic AI throughout the product lifecycle and extended value chain.

The world's largest manufacturers leverage Aras Innovator to manage complex product lifecycles, accelerate innovation, improve operational efficiency, and bring products to market faster. We collaborate with companies in some of the world's most innovative industries, including automotive, industrial equipment, aerospace and defense, high tech, and life sciences.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will be a key contributor to the design, development, and delivery of platform and platform applications that power Aras Innovator.

Design, develop, and maintain platform and platform applications/components across on-prem and SaaS environments
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code using modern engineering best practices
Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and cloud deployments
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine scope, manage technical risks, and ensure successful delivery
Improve platform reliability, scalability, performance, and security
Work across multiple projects, product areas, and technical domains, quickly adapting to changing business priorities
Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer-reported issues, performance challenges, and production defects
Participate in customer-driven initiatives, balancing strategic platform investments with customer requests and operational needs
Independently analyze problems, propose solutions, and drive implementation with minimal supervision
Comfortable leveraging AI tools to accelerate development, troubleshooting, code reviews, documentation, and learning

Who You Are

A proactive and self-driven engineer who takes ownership and delivers results with minimal supervision
Embraces modern AI-assisted development practices and continuously explores ways to improve engineering productivity through AI tools
Comfortable switching between multiple initiatives, priorities, and problem domains based on business needs
Customer-focused and motivated to solve real customer challenges through sustainable technical solutions
Able to quickly learn new technologies, systems, and product areas
Strong problem solver who can independently investigate, troubleshoot, and drive issues to resolution
Effective communicator who collaborates well with engineering, product management, support, and customer-facing teams
Passionate about continuous improvement, quality, and long-term maintainability
Team-oriented and willing to share knowledge and support others when needed

What You’ll Need

6–8+ years of experience in commercial software development
Experience with Customer Switching
Experience effectively using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, Claude, or similar technologies
Ability to incorporate AI tools into daily development workflows while maintaining high standards of code quality and security
Strong expertise in C# / .NET
Solid understanding of DevOps and CI/CD practices
Strong knowledge of SQL Server and T-SQL
Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, clean architecture, and design patterns
Experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with HTTP-based standards such as OData
Experience working in Agile development environments
Upper-intermediate or higher English (spoken and written)

Nice to have:

Experience with client-side or frontend development
Experience building and operating cloud-based systems (Azure preferred)
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes (AKS or Azure Container Apps), and Helm

jobs.title: Senior C# Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Seeking talented professionals to join our team of software engineers. Benefits include a friendly and stable work environment in a well established, multinational corporation with a rich heritage and long history. This team is remote first, with the option of working in an office with Foosball, Ping Pong tables, and tons of other great benefits on-site with open and flexible workspaces. Work schedule is flexible and the environment is casual and relaxed. Enjoy working in a community with many passionate software professionals like yourself. Not only will you be exposed to many interesting, diverse people and learn new skills, you’ll also have fun.

The Artificial Intelligence Services Team is implementing AI as a tool to unlock game changing features for Motorola to be the cutting edge in safety software solutions. We work closely with our AI teams, and public safety portfolio, to implement revolutionary advancements in leveraging images, audio, and video with data science and machine learning technologies. Positivity, Openness, Respect, Trust, and willingness to help others are crucial behaviors we encourage on this team.

Some technologies we use: C#, .NET Core, XUnit, Python, Scala, Linux Containers, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD using yml and C#, Azure Cloud including Service Bus, Cosmos DB, and both self deployed and Azure Cache for Redis, Frontier AI models like OpenAI and Gemini.

Job Description

Software engineer engaged in an engineering scrum team, producing world-class public safety software solutions ‘in the cloud’.
Produces mission-critical, real-time solutions that will affect the public directly, and may save lives.
Learning to create solid, well engineered code, resulting in maintainable, testable, scalable, performant, highly available, and sophisticated enterprise level systems and services.
Engages in Agile and Scrum practices including participation during the work breakdown of features, groomed Stories, and estimation of stories for two week sprints.
Communicates and collaborates effectively with co-workers..
Demonstrates flexibility and resilience to changes in company focus, and user needs, for Motorola to maintain market superiority.
Self-starter, able to understand, and verbally express, software development concepts precisely and concisely. Learning to create well written artifacts.

Basic Requirements

About You

Background in modern software development practices, principles, and tools, open to discussion, and working well within a team.
Results driven, and disciplined engineer learning to create solid, well crafted code.
Enthusiasm for increasing and exploring new technologies.
Willingness to mentor, and share knowledge and experience with respect for others.

MUST HAVE

3-4 years of experience in building application
Expertise in an object oriented language: C#
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
Understands Web APIs and REST
Understanding of how to build and deploy code, Bonus if experience building CI/CD pipelines
Understanding of testing code: bonus for experience creating unit and functional automation, load, performance, and security testing.

BONUS POINTS FOR

Experience in teams using Agile and Scrum processes.
Experience with gRPC
Experience in Python
Experience working in microservice principles and architectures
Kubernetes and Docker or other containerized solutions.
Developing cloud based solutions in Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Diagnosis and debugging techniques like network tracing, threat analysis, log analysis, reading APM logs from cloud based solutions, and system analysis including kubectl commands.

Travel Requirements

Under 10%

Relocation Provided

Domestic

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Company

Motorola Solutions Systems Polska Sp.z.o.o

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.
